content.text: Academic RequirementsAdmissions OverviewHigh School DiplomaCommon AppClass RankCredit for AP ClassesSAT/ACTTOEFL, IELTS, or DETRequired for International StudentsCollege Prep ProgramRequired - Varies by ProgramAdditional MaterialsLetters of Recommendation Writing SupplementGPA RequirementsCarnegie Mellon University does not have a strict minimum GPA requirement for undergraduate admissions. However, admitted students typically have very high GPAs, ranging from 3.7 to 4.0, with an average GPA of 3.9.3.9Average High School GPA3.8 - 4.025th-7th PercentileSAT RequirementsCarnegie Mellon is test optional currently for the admissions cycle. Carnegie Mellon University's SAT scores for admitted students range from 1500 to 1560, with an average score of 1530. Although SAT scores are optional, we recommend that students aim for a good SAT score of at least 1530 to be competitive in the admissions process at Carnegie Mellon University.1500 - 156025th-75th Percentile50%Students submitting SAT scoresACT RequirementsCarnegie Mellon is test optional for the next admissions cycle. Carnegie Mellon University's ACT scores for admitted students range from 33 to 35, with an average score of 34. A good ACT score will still boost your application above the competition and help get you into your dream school. It will allow admissions officers to quickly and objectively compare you to the rest of the applicant pool.33-3525th-75th Percentile20%Students submitting ACT scoresOther RequirementsBesides academic grades, Carnegie Mellon has some specific college prep requirements, and other requirements, based on the college and program of study you apply for.ExtracurricularsMake sure you have extracurriculars relating to your area of study and those that show your dedication over time.Recommendation LettersCarnegie Mellon University requires one teacher recommendation and one counselor recommendation.TOEFL, IELTS, or DETRequired for international students.Helpful ResourcesFind the US College that best suits you!Use Crimson's US College Admissions Calculator to generate a list of recommended colleges that are the best fit for you.
